written.headline: Nvidia spy scandal exposes Singapore chip networks evading US export controls
written.summary: The Nvidia spy scandal has exposed networks operating in Singapore that help Chinese tech companies access advanced U.S. AI chips and circumvent export controls. Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company linked to alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years.

written.headline: Cogent and OpenAI build cyber defense factories for enterprises
written.summary: Cogent and OpenAI are building cyber defense factories for enterprises. The system combines OpenAI models with enterprise context to help automatically remediate vulnerabilities with agents.

written.headline: Jensen Huang affair raises chances of US chip export limits in NDAA
written.summary: Sources report that Jensen Huang's affair has significantly raised the chances of Congress enacting chip export limits this year. The measure is being considered via the National Defense Authorization Act.

written.headline: Bonbon foundation model exhibits emergent biological capabilities
written.summary: Adi Mashiach introduced Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. The model exhibits zero-shot emergent capabilities across functional, residue, and bond levels of resolution.

written.headline: PLA-linked Chinese university obtained Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist
written.summary: Procurement records show that China's Northwestern Polytechnical University bought Nvidia H200 chips and rented computing capacity last month despite being on a US export blacklist. The purchases highlight gaps in Washington's export controls aimed at restricting China's access to advanced technology.

written.headline: Earlybird model predicts spoken words before speakers finish them
written.summary: Sahil Mahendrakar introduced Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming speech recognizer that predicts words before speakers finish them. On test sets, the model predicted the median word correctly 90 ms before the speaker finished speaking.

written.headline: PuppyGraph raises $10m Series A to help AI agents query enterprise tables
written.summary: PuppyGraph has raised a $10 million Series A round led by Particle Future to support engineering and enterprise expansion. The funding follows the general availability of PuppyGraph 1.0, which allows AI agents to query up to 3,000 enterprise tables as a unified graph.

written.headline: Bombay High Court quashes customs order citing AI-hallucinated judgments
written.summary: The Bombay High Court quashed a customs department order after the petitioner pointed out that the decision cited two non-existent Supreme Court judgments. The customs department agreed to scrap the order, and the court directed the commissioner to issue a fresh decision.
